prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='CWT_rf', seasonality_champion='ONLY_FT_rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: CWT_rf dominates as trend champion (1.0 trend correlation) and overall champion (RMSE=1.0737), while ONLY_FT_rf leads in seasonality capture (0.1848 seasonal correlation). The extreme RMSE spread and high model disagreement suggest STL-hierarchical stacking to exploit decomposition-aware combination, with mixed weighting to balance trend and seasonality strengths across the wavelet-transformed ensemble.
